trigger: P0576C proved that high-p source-plane gains are a near-affine mass-sheet/source-collapse degeneracy.
question: Does any modest routed propagator improve held-out raw positions when source residuals are converted back to the image plane through the local lens Jacobian?

metric.reported_statistic: RMS norm of delta_theta in arcseconds
metric.reason: The Jacobian inversion prevents a near-critical affine mass sheet from receiving an artificially zero score.

selection.amplitude: For each candidate, minimize calibration image-plane RMS over one nonnegative overall amplitude using a fixed dense scan plus bounded refinement.
selection.candidate: Select minimum calibration image-plane RMS, then score held-out families without refitting p, f, or amplitude.

claim_limits: Linearized image-plane residuals are stronger than source-plane scatter but are not full nonlinear root finding.
The singular-value floor is a declared numerical regularization and must be varied later.
The same SMACS positions are reused and only this metric/formula selection is prospective.
One overall amplitude is fitted; absolute gravity strength remains unpredicted.
